lines.en: label chinamispring3:
scene othersky
The sky was upside down when I stepped outside today.
lines.zh: 今天我走出门时，天是倒过来的。

lines.en: You probably can’t tell, but I can.
lines.zh: 你大概看不出来，但我看得出来。

lines.en: The birds were flying backwards as they tried to catch the bus, and every single parked car made it to its destination long before the ones that drove.
lines.zh: 鸟儿倒着飞，想追上那班公交车；而每一辆停着的车，都远比那些开着的车更早抵达目的地。

lines.en: You probably don’t know what that means, but I do.
lines.zh: 你大概不知道那意味着什么，但我知道。

lines.en: I’m the king of everything — with a black paper crown and cuff-links sewn by silkworms in the final days before they slither along to their sideways school on Backwards Boulevard.
lines.zh: 我是万物之王——头戴黑纸王冠，袖扣由蚕吐丝缝就，那是它们滑向倒退大道上那所歪斜学校之前的最后几日。

lines.en: And when they get there, they’ll think.
lines.zh: 等它们到了那儿，它们会思考。

lines.en: When they get there, they’ll think — why sleep in cocoons when Heaven’s Web is so much sweeter?
lines.zh: 等它们到了那儿，它们会思考——既然天网如此甜美，何必睡在茧里？

lines.en: Why drown in the darkness when there’s a room full of white just waiting to be drenched in every color we can pull from the rainbow?
lines.zh: 既然有一整屋的纯白，正等着被我们从彩虹里撷取来的每一种颜色浸透，何必溺死在黑暗里？

lines.en: And they’ll think these things not because they’re silkworms, no. They will think these things because their tamer planted thoughts in those tiny silkworm brains.
lines.zh: 而它们会这样想，并非因为它们是蚕，不是。它们会这样想，是因为它们的驯养者把念头种进了那些小小的蚕脑里。

lines.en: That was me — the slaver of the silk moth. The one who walks on his hands, opening the blinds at night and stealing money out of cash registers from each and every one of this town’s greengrocers.
lines.zh: 那就是我——蚕蛾的奴役者。那个用手走路的人，在夜里拉开百叶窗，从镇上每一家蔬果店的收银机里偷钱。

lines.en: They’re better than the blue ones.
lines.zh: 它们比蓝色的好。

lines.en: They’re better than the red ones.
lines.zh: 它们比红色的好。

lines.en: But they’ll never beat the scent nor sense of soft skin or that first glimpse of a ring in a realm where shapes are secrets, stuffed in the backseat of a car that cannot park.
lines.zh: 但它们永远赢不过柔软肌肤的气味与触感，也赢不过在那个形状皆为秘密的国度里瞥见的第一枚戒指——被塞进一辆无法停靠的车后座里。

lines.en: I will never get to where I’m going.
lines.zh: 我永远到不了我要去的地方。

lines.en: I will never be what I’m supposed to be.
lines.zh: 我永远成不了我本该成为的样子。

lines.en: scene sky
But at least my legs still work.
lines.zh: 但至少我的腿还能动。

lines.en: : Hello?
scene gpmx1
: i got a new job at the great pareidolia mall
lines.zh: : 我在 pareidolia 大商场找了份新工作

lines.en: : congratulations chika
lines.zh: : 恭喜啊 chika

lines.en: : yeah so i need you to go watch chinami
lines.zh: : 嗯 所以我想让你去看着 chinami

lines.en: : i know i got kind of crazy the other day and you might feel weird about that or whatever but she has a fever and i don’t want her to die
lines.zh: : 我知道前几天我有点疯 你可能会觉得别扭什么的 但她发烧了 我不想她死

lines.en: : neither do i so don’t worry yeah i’ll handle it
lines.zh: : 我也不想 所以别担心 嗯 我来搞定

lines.en: : okay awesome and don’t have sex with her either
lines.zh: : 好 太好了 还有 别跟她上床

lines.en: : but what if the voices in my head want me to
lines.zh: : 可要是我脑子里的声音想让我上呢

lines.en: : don’t listen to them lol
lines.zh: : 别听它们的 lol

lines.en: : anyway i gotta go
lines.zh: : 总之我得走了

lines.en: : there’s a hole this one girl wants me to look at or something before my shift starts
lines.zh: : 有个洞 某个女孩想让我开工前去看一眼什么的

lines.en: : if she tells you she didn’t push her last boyfriend into it she’s telling the truth
lines.zh: : 要是她跟你说她没把她上一任男友推进去 那她说的是真话

lines.en: : okay
lines.zh: : 好

lines.zh: : 她真的没干

lines.zh: : 好啦 sensei

lines.zh: : 真的

lines.zh: : 嗯嗯 行 我懂了

lines.zh: : 好啦 爱你 拜

lines.en: scene black
scene chinamifeverwatch1
scene chinamifeverwatch2
: I’m here and I’m ready to be a good guy.
lines.zh: : 我到了，准备好当个好人了。

lines.en: Hello. My name is Akira Arakawa. I have a wife named Chika and a daughter named Chinami.
lines.zh: 你好。我叫 Akira Arakawa。我有一个妻子叫 Chika，一个女儿叫 Chinami。

lines.en: These are not delusions. This is my real life. And these are things I definitely believe because that’s the only thing that makes any of this somewhat acceptable.
lines.zh: 这些不是妄想。这是我的真实人生。而这些是我确信无疑的事，因为唯有如此，这一切才勉强能让人接受。

lines.en: Today, I will protect my daughter from the sweet release of death.
lines.zh: 今天，我要保护我的女儿，不让她被死亡甜美地解脱。

lines.en: She has an immunodeficiency disorder that really only pops up in random sections of the game, but such is life when you have to split your time between so many vaginas.
lines.zh: 她患有免疫缺陷，而这毛病其实只在游戏的随机段落里冒出来，不过当你得把时间分摊给那么多阴道时，人生就是这样。

lines.en: I mean girls. You can never have too many vaginas.
lines.zh: 我是说女孩。阴道永远不嫌多。

lines.en: But some vaginas are worse to penis than others. That’s what mall Chika was alluding to in that scene that definitely happened a few seconds ago.
lines.zh: 但有些阴道对阴茎来说比别的更糟。商场 Chika 在几秒前那场确实发生过的戏里暗指的，就是这个。

lines.en: So yeah, let’s hope I don’t accidentally get too horny and penis today too.
lines.zh: 所以呢，希望我今天也不会一不小心就发情、就阴茎。

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch3
scene chinamifeverwatch2
: Lucy. I’m hoooooouuuse.
lines.zh: : Lucy。我回————家————啦。

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch4
Before me lies one more of God’s unfinished projects.
lines.zh: 躺在我面前的，是上帝又一桩未完成的作品。

lines.en: I won’t bore you with another long-winded rant about how she’s not meant for this place, though.
lines.zh: 不过我就不再拿那套冗长的牢骚来烦你了——说她本不属于这个地方什么的。

lines.en: Such a thing would be depressing. And you already had to sit through whatever the hell was going on inside of my head on the way over, so I imagine you’re already a little exhausted or whatever.
lines.zh: 那太让人沮丧了。而且来时的路上，你已经硬着头皮听完了在我脑子里折腾的那堆乱七八糟的东西，所以我想你大概已经有点累了什么的。

lines.en: And I am too.
lines.zh: 我也一样。

lines.en: It’s another one of those days — where I can’t figure out who I am or what I want or who I want or what I am. And it’s on those days where I suffer the most.
lines.zh: 又是那样的一天——搞不清自己是谁、想要什么、想要谁、自己又是什么。而正是在这样的日子里，我最受折磨。

lines.en: Yet, it’s somehow not as much as her.
lines.zh: 然而，再怎么样也比不上她。

lines.en: I doubt she’ll {i}die.{/i} I mean, she hasn’t {i}so{/i} far.
lines.zh: 我怀疑她不会{i}死{/i}。我是说，到目前为止她还没。

lines.en: But there’s always the chance that she {i}could.{/i}
lines.zh: 但她{i}有可能{/i}死，这个可能始终存在。

lines.en: And when I walk out of my house in the morning and glance up at that directionless sky, I can normally convince myself pretty easily that I’m not going to contract pneumonia and abandon this world.
lines.zh: 而当我早晨走出家门，抬头望向那片没有方向的天空时，我通常能很容易地说服自己：我不会染上肺炎、抛下这个世界。

lines.en: Her breathing is labored. Her skin glistens in the small bit of light sneaking in through the window. And despite the AC being turned up as high as it will go, just {i}looking{/i} at her makes me feel hot.
lines.zh: 她呼吸费力。她的皮肤在从窗口溜进来的一小片光里泛着光泽。尽管空调已经开到最大，光是{i}看着{/i}她，我就觉得热。

lines.en: Maybe a little too hot.
lines.zh: 也许，热得有点过头了。

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch5
: Nngh! Ackh......mngkh.......agh.......
lines.zh: : Nngh! Ackh......mngkh.......agh.......

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch6
Stifled coughing — without the head of a dog to mask it this time.
lines.zh: 压抑的咳嗽——这次没有狗头来替它打掩护。

lines.en: But...what am I supposed to do, exactly?
lines.zh: 可是……我到底该做什么？

lines.en: I told Chika I’d take care of her while she’s at work (I think). But I can’t treat Chinami the way I treat Ami whenever {i}she’s{/i} feeling sick by just crawling into bed and holding her until she’s feeling better.
lines.zh: 我跟 Chika 说过{i}她{/i}上班时我会照顾她（大概吧）。但我不能像对待 Ami 那样对待 Chinami——「她」一生病，我就爬上床抱着她，直到她好起来。

lines.en: I should replace her towel, at least. Soak it in cold water and wipe the sweat from her- wait. No. That’s too much, isn’t it?
lines.zh: 至少我该换掉她的毛巾。用冷水浸湿，擦掉她身上的汗——等等。不。这太过了，对吧？

lines.en: And...am I even sure the water is supposed to be cold? Or is this like eating ramen in the summer to stay cool?
lines.zh: 而且……我确定水该是冷的吗？还是说，这跟夏天吃拉面来降温是一个道理？

lines.en: I pull out my phone and begin frantically researching how to care for a sick girl.
lines.zh: 我掏出手机，开始疯狂搜索该怎么照顾一个生病的女孩。

lines.en: I’m probably just overreacting. But...still. It’s possible she caught this from {i}me{/i} the last time I came over, so I don’t want to go and make things even worse.
lines.zh: 我大概只是反应过度。但……还是。她有可能是上次{i}我{/i}来的时候被「我」传染的，所以我不想再把事情弄得更糟。

lines.en: I’ve already given one Chosokabe rabies after all. And if the Internet is correct in telling me I need to make sure Chinami stays hydrated, having her averse to water might become somewhat problematic.
lines.zh: 毕竟我已经让一个 Chosokabe 染上过狂犬病了。而如果网上说的没错，我得确保 Chinami 补充水分，那她讨厌水这一点可能就会有点麻烦。

lines.en: scene black
I grab the washcloth off of her pillow and make my way over to the sink.
lines.zh: 我从她枕边拿起毛巾，走向洗手池。

lines.en: On hotter days, it takes about twenty seconds or so for the water to get cold. I think the pipes in this building might be exposed to the sun or something like that. I don’t know. I’m no plumber.
lines.zh: 天热的日子里，水要过大概二十秒才会变凉。我觉得这栋楼的管道可能暴露在太阳底下什么的。我不知道。我又不是水管工。

lines.en: But in those twenty seconds, I have time to think. And even though it’s {i}only{/i} twenty seconds, as I stand there with my hand under that steady stream of water, it feels like an eternity.
lines.zh: 但在这二十秒里，我有时间思考。尽管{i}只有{/i}二十秒，可当我站在那里，把手伸在那道稳定的水流下时，它却漫长得像永恒。

lines.en: I think of the first time I met Chinami — how she ran to the living room of that old, crumbling apartment and showed me a picture of her dead mother.
lines.zh: 我想起初见 Chinami 的那天——她如何跑进那间破旧公寓的客厅，给我看她死去母亲的照片。

lines.en: I remember thinking in that moment of how desperately I wanted to protect her. To build her a castle. Have her sister be my queen so she can be my princess and {i}I{/i} can be the king.
lines.zh: {i}我{/i}记得那一刻我是多么拼命地想要保护她。为她建一座城堡。让她的姐姐做我的王后，这样她就能做我的公主，而「我」来做国王。

lines.en: So why?...
lines.zh: 那么为什么？……

lines.en: Why, as days go by, is that desire to {i}protect{/i} turning to one that makes me fearful of being alone with her?
lines.zh: 为什么随着日子一天天过去，那份「{i}保护{/i}」的欲望，正在变成一种让我害怕与她独处的恐惧？

lines.en: Is that really who I am?
lines.zh: 我真的就是这样的人吗？

lines.en: Have I learned {i}nothing{/i} after all these years?
lines.zh: 这么多年过去，我{i}什么{/i}都没学到吗？

lines.en: Or do I look back on the days when I was just as small as her and pretend that things just weren’t all that bad?
lines.zh: 还是说，我回望自己和她一般小的那些日子，假装有那么糟而已？

lines.en: Some days, I have an answer.
lines.zh: 有些日子，我有答案。

lines.en: Some days, I don’t.
lines.zh: 有些日子，我没有。

lines.en: Ah...
How long has the water been cold?
lines.zh: 水已经凉了多久了？

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch7
I picked up a book from a convenience store on the way over. I figured it would help distract me from anything I might do or feel today. Escapism at its finest, I say.
lines.zh: 来的路上，我在便利店买了本书。我想它能帮我从今天可能做出或可能感觉到的一切里分神。最顶级的逃避现实，我说。

lines.en: I also picked up breakfast. Two croquettes and a red bean bun.
lines.zh: 我还买了早饭。两个可乐饼和一个豆沙包。

lines.en: The last time I ate croquettes, I burnt my tongue. So I ate the red bean bun first this time and gave my second course a few minutes to cool off.
lines.zh: 上次吃可乐饼，我烫到了舌头。所以这次我先吃了豆沙包，给第二道菜留几分钟凉一凉。

lines.en: The result is that my tongue is fine — so now I can bite down on it to try and shock away any impurities that avoid the book and find me in the real world.
lines.zh: 结果就是我的舌头没事——所以现在我可以咬住它，试着用痛感驱散那些绕过书本、在现实世界里找上我的杂念。

lines.en: It’s been a while since I’ve actually read. Maybe this is me turning the page? Pun somewhat intended. But also not. I want to change.
lines.zh: 我很久没有真正读过书了。也许这就是我在翻开新的一页？双关多少是有意的。但也并不全是。我想要改变。

lines.en: I want to be a better man.
lines.zh: 我想做一个更好的人。

lines.en: I want to move away from Backwards Boulevard and buy a {i}new{/i} house. Somewhere between Apathy Avenue and Sympathy Street sounds nice.
lines.zh: 我想搬离倒退大道，买一栋「{i}新{/i}」房子。在冷漠大道和同情街之间找个地方听起来不错。

lines.en: Anywhere I can look outside the window and immediately discern which direction the birds will be flying in today.
lines.zh: 任何一处能让我望向窗外，就立刻判断出今天鸟儿会往哪个方向飞的地方。

lines.en: A man can dream, I suppose.
lines.zh: 人总可以做梦吧，我想。

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch8
: Mnh...
lines.zh: : Mnh...

lines.en: A man {i}has{/i} to dream. Because man is evil. Man is impure. Man is the culmination of instinct and desire and fury and spite all balled into a single, black orb that could consume the world if left alone.
lines.zh: 人{i}必须{/i}做梦。因为人是邪恶的。人是不洁的。人是本能、欲望、暴怒与怨毒揉成的一个黑球，若是放任不管，它能吞噬整个世界。

lines.en: And with that in mind, it’s no wonder that God Himself is the complete opposite.
lines.zh: 想到这一点，上帝本人恰恰完全相反也就不足为奇了。

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch9
: Papa?...
lines.zh: : Papa？……

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch10
: Oh, you’re awake.
lines.zh: : 哦，你醒了。

lines.en: : Congratulations on still being alive.
lines.zh: : 恭喜你还活着。

lines.en: : What are you doing here?...
lines.zh: : 你在这儿干什么？……

lines.en: : Your sister called me. She had to go to work and wanted me to look after you.
lines.zh: : 你姐姐给我打了电话。她得去上班，想让我来照顾你。

lines.en: : So...does that mean you’ll be taking care of Chinami today?...
lines.zh: : 所以……那意思是今天你来照顾 Chinami 了？……

lines.en: : I guess so.
lines.zh: : 应该是吧。

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch11
: Yay! That means we can play games!
lines.zh: : 好耶！那我们可以玩游戏了！

lines.en: : No. It means you can lie there and rest because that’s what the Internet says you’re supposed to be doing right now.
lines.zh: : 不行。那意味着你可以躺在那儿休息，因为网上说你现在正该这么做。

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch12
: Rats...
lines.zh: : 可恶……

lines.en: : Chinami would hate the Internet if it wasn’t full of valuable stock tips and pictures of dogs.
lines.zh: : Chinami 会恨死互联网的，如果它上面没有有价值的股票建议和狗的照片的话。

lines.en: : Do you need anything? Water? Food? I can order, like...what do sick people normally eat? Soup?
lines.zh: : 你需要什么吗？水？吃的？我可以点外卖，比如……病人一般吃什么？汤？

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch13
: Peanuts.
lines.zh: : 花生。

lines.en: : Are you {i}trying{/i} to get me to kill you?
lines.zh: : 你是{i}想{/i}让我杀了你吗？

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch14
: No. Chinami just wanted to see if you remembered her weakness.
lines.zh: : 不是。Chinami 只是想看看你还记不记得她的弱点。

lines.en: : She’s thankful she has such a caring Papa who keeps track of her allergies and plays games with her when she’s sick.
lines.zh: : 她很感激自己有这么体贴的 Papa，记得她的过敏，还在她生病时陪她玩游戏。

lines.en: : No games. Go back to sleep.
lines.zh: : 不玩。回去睡觉。

lines.en: : But Chinami isn’t tired anymore. She’s super excited that her daddy came over to play this time and not fight with anybody.
lines.zh: : 可 Chinami 已经不困了。她超级兴奋，因为这次爸爸是过来陪她玩的，不是来跟谁吵架的。

lines.en: : Can you make Chinami pancakes?
lines.zh: : 你能给 Chinami 做松饼吗？

lines.en: : As a matter of fact, I can. I learned how to do that when my {i}other{/i} daughter was...sick.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我能。我{i}另一个{/i}女儿……生病的时候，我学会了怎么做。

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch15
: Yaaaay! Chinami gets to-
lines.zh: : 好耶——！Chinami 可以——

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch16
: OTHER DAUGHTER?!?!?!
lines.zh: : 另一个女儿？！？！？！

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch17
: What other daughter?! Is this why big sis Chika was mad and scary the last time you came over?! Does Chinami have a half-sister now?! Does-
lines.zh: : 什么另一个女儿？！上次你来的时候 Chika 姐姐又凶又吓人，难道是因为这个？！Chinami 现在有个同父异母的妹妹了吗？！难道——

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch18
: Ackh!!! Ackkhk...mmnfhck...ackhhh!!!!
lines.zh: : Ackh!!! Ackkhk...mmnfhck...ackhhh!!!!

lines.en: : Chinami, take it easy. I’m pretty sure you’re not supposed to be yelling like that when you’re sick.
lines.zh: : Chinami，别激动。我很确定你生病的时候不该这么大喊大叫。

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch19
: Of course Chinami is going to yell if you’re going to drop a bomb on her like that! She never even got to hold the baby!
lines.zh: : 你这样突然扔下一个炸弹，Chinami 当然要喊了！她连抱都没抱过那个宝宝！

lines.en: : I’m not talking about an {i}actual{/i} daughter. I’ve just started calling my niece that since it’s been just me and her for over half of her life now.
lines.zh: : 我说的不是{i}亲生{/i}女儿。我只是开始管我侄女那么叫，毕竟她这辈子有一大半时间都是我跟她两个人过来的。

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch20
: Niece? You mean the one big sis Chika says is evil all the time?
lines.zh: : 侄女？你是说 Chika 姐姐总说是坏人的那个？

lines.en: : That sounds about right, yeah.
lines.zh: : 听起来差不多，嗯。

lines.en: : So...Chinami doesn’t have a new sister?
lines.zh: : 所以……Chinami 没有新的妹妹？

lines.en: : Nope. So Chinami doesn’t have to worry about someone else taking up even more of my time.
lines.zh: : 没有。所以 Chinami 不用担心有别的人再占掉我更多的时间。

lines.en: : That’s good news, Papa. But it would be better news if you could start coming more often again. Big sis Chika’s been kind of scary lately.
lines.zh: : 那是个好消息，Papa。不过要是你能重新常来，那就是更好的消息了。Chika 姐姐最近有点吓人。

lines.en: : Yeah...but hopefully, she and I can...figure that out or something since it’s basically all my fault.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不过希望她跟我能……把事情理清楚什么的，毕竟基本上都是我的错。

lines.en: : Blah, blah, blah. Chinami doesn’t care about that stuff. Chinami wants pancakes now that her Papa knows how to make them. And Chinami will grade them very harshly.
lines.zh: : blah blah blah。Chinami 才不在乎那些事。既然 Papa 会做，Chinami 现在就要松饼。而且 Chinami 会给它们打很严格的分。

lines.en: : Technically, I never said I {i}would{/i} make you pancakes. Just that I {i}can.{/i}
lines.zh: : 严格来说，我从没说{i}会{/i}给你做松饼。只说了{i}会做{/i}。

lines.en: : While Chinami understands that you may fear her grading criteria, she would like to inform you that {i}not{/i} making her pancakes could lead to great regret as Chinami could die at any moment.
lines.zh: : Chinami 理解你可能害怕她的评分标准，但她想通知你，{i}不{/i}给她做松饼可能会导致巨大的遗憾，因为 Chinami 随时都可能死掉。

lines.en: : Don’t leverage your illness against me for pancakes, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 别拿你的病当筹码来换松饼，Chinami。

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch21
: What good is Chinami’s fragile body if she can’t even use it for sweets?!
lines.zh: : 如果 Chinami 这副脆弱的身体连换甜点都派不上用场，那还有什么意思？！

lines.en: : I’m sorry. But the Internet says-
lines.zh: : 抱歉。可网上说——

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch22
: Chinami knows what the Internet says. Big sis Chika makes Chinami eat healthy food when Chinami is sick too. But Papa is irresponsible so Chinami thought Papa would be different.
lines.zh: : Chinami 知道网上说什么。Chinami 生病的时候，Chika 姐姐也让她吃健康食品。但 Papa 是个不负责任的人，所以 Chinami 还以为 Papa 会不一样呢。

lines.en: : I can order you soup. I have, regretfully, not learned how to make that yet.
lines.zh: : 我可以给你点汤。遗憾的是，我还没学会怎么做那个。

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch23
: How hot do we make it? Is it possible to burn soup?
lines.zh: : 汤要多热才行？汤有可能烫坏吗？

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch24
: And I likely never will...
lines.zh: : 而且我大概永远也学不会……

lines.en: : Okay. Chinami will eat Papa’s special delivery soup. But she wants to take a bath first since she’s all sweaty.
lines.zh: : 好吧。Chinami 会吃 Papa 特送的外卖汤。但她想先洗个澡，因为她一身汗。

lines.en: : Great. Do you need me to warm it up for you or do you know how to do that yourself?
lines.zh: : 好。需要我帮你把洗澡水调热，还是你自己会弄？

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch25
: Chinami knows how. She can do it.
lines.zh: : Chinami 会。她自己能行。

lines.en: : Okay. I’ll place an order now, then. And hopefully, by the time you’re done, it’ll be here.
lines.zh: : 好。那我现在就下单。希望等你洗完，它也就到了。

lines.en: : Is Papa not coming into the bath with Chinami?
lines.zh: : Papa 不跟 Chinami 一起进浴室吗？

lines.en: : Absolutely not.
lines.zh: : 绝对不行。

lines.en: if sawchinami == True:
: But he’s already done it before.
lines.zh: : 可他以前做过啊。

lines.en: : He certainly has not.
lines.zh: : 他绝对没有。

lines.en: : He sure has. Him, big sis Chika, and Chinami all took a bath together in Chinami’s old apartment.
lines.zh: : 他真的做过。他、Chika 姐姐和 Chinami 在 Chinami 以前那间公寓里一起洗过澡。

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t think you’re remembering that event correctly. I kind of just walked in and then felt really weird.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我觉得你没记对。我就是不小心走进去，然后觉得非常别扭。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because it’s not normal for grown men to be in the bathroom with little girls.
lines.zh: : 因为成年男人和小女孩一起待在浴室里，不正常。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Many reasons, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 很多原因，Chinami。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Do you think you can just keep asking “why?” until I agree?
lines.zh: : 你以为只要一直问「为什么？」我就会答应吗？

lines.en: else:
: Because it’s not normal for grown men to be in the bathroom with little girls.
lines.zh: : 因为成年男人和小女孩一起待在浴室里，不正常。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Many reasons, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 很多原因，Chinami。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Do you think you can just keep asking “why?” until I agree?
lines.zh: : 你以为只要一直问「为什么？」我就会答应吗？

lines.en: : Chinami’s just worried that she’ll fall and crack her head open and bleed everywhere and die. Or that she’ll faint in the bathtub and drown and never get to eat Papa’s special soup.
lines.zh: : Chinami 只是担心自己会摔倒、把头磕裂，血流得到处都是然后死掉。或者在浴缸里晕过去淹死，再也吃不到 Papa 的特制汤了。

lines.en: : Chinami needs to stop being so morbid.
lines.zh: : Chinami 别老是这么病态。

lines.en: : Big sis Chika always gets in the bath with Chinami when Chinami is sick.
lines.zh: : Chinami 生病的时候，Chika 姐姐总是陪 Chinami 一起洗澡。

lines.en: : She’s your sister. I’m some random guy she’s “dating.”
lines.zh: : 她是你的姐姐。我只是个她在「交往」的陌生男人。

lines.en: : No, you’re my Papa.
lines.zh: : 不，你是我的 Papa。

lines.en: : That’s what you call me, sure. That’s not what I actually {i}am,{/i} though.
lines.zh: : 你确实这么叫我。可那并不是我真正的{i}身份{/i}。

lines.en: : But that’s what you are to {i}me.{/i} I mean...Chinami.
lines.zh: : 但对「我」来说，你就是。{i}我{/i}是说……对 Chinami 来说。

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch26
: Pleeeeeeease, Papa? Chinami’s arms don’t bend back the way they’re supposed to and she has a hard time reaching everywhere. She needs your help or she will die.
lines.zh: : 求——求你了，Papa？Chinami 的手臂弯不到该弯的地方，有些地方够不着。她需要你帮忙，不然她会死的。

lines.en: : Pleeeeeeeease?...
if sawchinami == True and tsukasachosen == True and tsukasarefused == False:
: Chinami...that’s a bad idea.
lines.zh: : Chinami……那是个坏主意。

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t think so. Chinami thinks-
lines.zh: : Chinami 不这么认为。Chinami 觉得——

lines.en: : Chinami is wrong.
lines.zh: : Chinami 是错的。

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch27
: Chinami doesn’t understand what she’s asking. She doesn’t understand {i}who{/i} she’s asking.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不明白自己在要求什么。她不明白自己在要求「{i}谁{/i}」。

lines.en: : If I was actually your dad...sure. Whatever. It’d be weird, but it wouldn’t be {i}as{/i} weird as it is with me being...{i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 如果我真是你爸爸……好吧。随便。那会很怪，但不会像现在这么怪——毕竟我是……{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: : But you’re just Papa. You’re-
lines.zh: : 可你就是 Papa。你是——

lines.en: : I’m not “just” anything. I’m the amalgamation of all that’s wrong with man. I’m a self-made victim of circumstance and a prisoner in my own mind and body.
lines.zh: : 我可不是「只是」什么。我是人类一切劣根的混合物。我是自己造就的境遇受害者，是自己心智与躯壳里的囚徒。

lines.en: : But more than that, I’m a virus that would surely kill you if the right...precautions aren’t taken.
lines.zh: : 但更重要的是，我是一种病毒，如果不采取恰当的……预防措施，我一定会害死你。

lines.en: : Chinami is confused by basically everything Papa just said. Are you saying you want to kill Chinami?
lines.zh: : Papa 刚才说的这些，Chinami 基本一句都没听懂。你是说你想杀掉 Chinami 吗？

lines.en: : Of course I don’t {i}want{/i} to. That’s just...
lines.zh: : 我当然「不{i}想{/i}」。只是……

lines.en: : I’m afraid that’s what would happen. And I want to {i}protect{/i} you. Which sometimes means...keeping my distance.
lines.zh: : 我只是怕事情会变成那样。而我想「{i}保护{/i}」你。而那有时候意味着……保持距离。

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch28
: Chinami trusts you, Papa.
lines.zh: : Chinami 信任你，Papa。

lines.en: : She shouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 她不该。

lines.en: : But she does.
lines.zh: : 可她就是信任。

lines.en: : So she’ll ask you one more time, then leave you alone if you still say no.
lines.zh: : 那她再问你最后一次，要是你还说不，她就不缠着你了。

lines.en: : Will you come with Chinami?
lines.zh: : 你愿意陪 Chinami 来吗？

lines.en: menu:
Endanger her
lines.zh: 置她于险地

lines.en: : Fine.
scene chinamifeverwatch30
: Yay! Chinami’s persuasion skill has improved! Now, she just needs to figure out how to convince Papa to make her pancakes.
lines.zh: : 好耶！Chinami 的说服技能提升了！现在，她只需要想办法说服 Papa 给她做松饼。

lines.en: : It’s actually disgusting that it was easier to convince me to do {i}this{/i} than that.
lines.zh: : 说实话挺恶心的——说服我做{i}这个{/i}，居然比说服我做那个还容易。

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch31
: Papa’s being too hard on himself again. Chinami is sure that everything is going to be fine. And now, she’ll be extra clean too!
lines.zh: : Papa 又对自己太苛刻了。Chinami 确信一切都会没事的。而且这样一来，她还会洗得特别干净！

lines.en: scene black
: Come on, Papa! Chinami will show you how to work the bath for when you move in with us.
lines.zh: : 来嘛，Papa！Chinami 会教你怎么用浴缸，等你搬来跟我们一起住的时候就用得上了。

lines.en: This is normal.
lines.zh: 这是正常的。

lines.en: scene imissyou12
{i}I{/i} am normal.
lines.zh: {i}我{/i}是正常的。

lines.en: scene tsukasaapt17
No. I’m {i}not{/i} normal. I am {i}anything{/i} but normal.
lines.zh: 不。我{i}不{/i}正常。我{i}根本{/i}不正常。

lines.en: scene utaparkscene25
But {i}this{/i} time, I am. And it doesn’t matter what I’ve done in the past so long as- no, wait. It {i}does{/i} matter what I’ve done in the past. But if I’m trying to get better, I-
lines.zh: 但{i}这一次{/i}，我是正常的。而我过去做过什么并不重要，只要——不，等等。我过去做过什么{i}确实{/i}重要。可如果我在努力变好，我——

lines.en: scene tsukasakura19
Uhh...
Right! If I’m trying to get better, I have to {b}CONFRONT{/b} these feelings! Running away is {b}BAD.{/b}
lines.zh: 对了！如果我想变好，我就必须{b}直面{/b}这些感觉！逃避是{b}不对的{/b}。

lines.en: scene 3
scene 2
scene 1
scene blood3
{b}I MUST BE A GOOD BOY.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}我必须做个好孩子。{/b}

lines.en: $ chinamispring3 = True
$ chinami_love += 1
$ chikablock = False
jump chinamispring4
Protect her
lines.zh: 保护她

lines.en: : I’m sorry. I just...really shouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 对不起。我只是……真的不该。

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch29
: Fiiiiine. But if Chinami dies, her ghost will never forgive you!
lines.zh: : 好————吧。可要是 Chinami 死了，她的鬼魂永远都不会原谅你！

lines.en: : It’ll have to get in line.
lines.zh: : 那它得排队。

lines.en: scene black
: I’m already being haunted.
lines.zh: : 我已经被鬼缠上了。

lines.en: {i}You refuse to give into temptation!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你拒绝向诱惑屈服！{/i}

lines.en: {i}You’re such a good guy and everyone’s really proud of you!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你真是个好人，大家都为你骄傲！{/i}

lines.en: {i}But in another life, you’re making the opposite choice.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但在另一世，你做出了相反的选择。{/i}

lines.en: {i}In another life, you’re not afraid of LINES. You’re not afraid of WHAT ISN’T REAL.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}在那一世，你不畏惧「台词」。你不畏惧「不真实之物」。{/i}

lines.en: {i}In that life, you’re strong. You’re brave. You’re human! And you can face your fears without worry that your weakness will amplify them!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}在那一世，你坚强。你勇敢。你是个人！你能直面自己的恐惧，不必担心你的软弱会把它们放大！{/i}

lines.en: {i}In that world, you can see things for what they are, not what they represent. And you can live freely, unburdened by the unfortunate truth that, in this world...you’re a coward.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}在那个世界里，你能看见事物本来的样子，而非它们所象征的东西。你能自由地活着，不必背负那个不幸的真相——在这个世界里……你是个懦夫。{/i}

lines.en: {i}You’re a creep.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你是个变态。{/i}

lines.en: {i}You hate the way these lines make you feel because you haven’t figured out how to separate them yet.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你讨厌这些台词带给你的感受，因为你还没学会如何把它们分开。{/i}

lines.en: {i}In the dark, another string snaps. And while you pat yourself on the back for a job well done, know this-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}黑暗中，又一根弦断了。而在你为自己干得漂亮而沾沾自喜时，请记住——{/i}

lines.en: {i}Everyone else is growing.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}其他人都在成长。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And you’ll never catch up at this rate.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}而照这个速度，你永远也追不上。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Chinami enjoys the soup!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Chinami 很享受这碗汤！{/i}

: Absolutely fucking not. Now go take a shower so I can order your food.
lines.zh: : 绝对他妈不行。现在去洗澡，好让我给你点吃的。

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch32
: Waaaaaaaah! Chinami’s Papa won’t even wash her back! Chinami will never experience real love! And at this rate, she’ll probably never even get to grow up before-
lines.zh: : 哇————！Chinami 的 Papa 连背都不肯给她搓！Chinami 永远体会不到真正的爱了！而且照这个样子，她大概还没长大就——

lines.en: scene chinamifeverwatch18
: Ackhkk! Akckk.....hckghgh.....ahgkckhck!
lines.zh: : Ackhkk! Akckk.....hckghgh.....ahgkckhck!

lines.en: scene black
: Just tell me what kind of soup you want...
lines.zh: : 直接告诉我要什么汤吧……

lines.en: Chinami leaves and takes a bath on her own.
lines.zh: Chinami 离开了，自己一个人去洗澡。

lines.en: I’m safer here. She’s safer there.
lines.zh: 我在这儿更安全。她在那儿更安全。

lines.en: And if I can keep doing this, I can...
lines.zh: 如果我能一直这样下去，我就能……

lines.en: If you’d have told me when I was younger that it’s possible to rewrite the past, I’m not sure how I would have reacted.
lines.zh: 如果在我还小的时候你告诉我，过去是可以改写的，我不知道自己会作何反应。

lines.en: But now that I know that you {i}can,{/i} it’s almost all I think about.
lines.zh: 但现在我知道「{i}可以{/i}」，这几乎成了我唯一想的事。

lines.en: There are some dishes left in the sink that I decide to take care of while waiting for Chinami to finish up.
lines.zh: 水槽里还剩几个盘子，我决定趁等 Chinami 洗完的工夫把它们洗了。

lines.en: The water is the perfect temperature as soon as I turn the faucet on.
lines.zh: 我一拧开水龙头，水温就正正好。

lines.en: I manage to avoid thinking entirely.
lines.zh: 我成功地什么都没想。
